title: Twenty Questions People Ask Before Their First Safari
excerpt: Twenty questions travellers ask before their first safari in Tanzania, with short, honest answers.
body:
## 1. When is the best time?
All year, depending on what you want. See [weather by month](/blog/tanzania-weather-by-month/).

## 2. How long should a safari be?
At least five days. See [how long should a safari be](/blog/how-long-safari-tanzania/).

## 3. Will I see the Big Five?
Chances are good on the northern circuit, but leopards and rhinos are not guaranteed.

## 4. Is it safe?
Yes, with a guide and normal precautions.

## 5. Do I need a visa?
Most travellers do. See [visa guide](/blog/tanzania-visa-guide/).

## 6. Do I need vaccinations?
Ask your doctor. See [vaccinations](/blog/tanzania-vaccinations/).

## 7. Is there malaria?
Yes, in most areas. See [malaria](/blog/malaria-tanzania/).

## 8. What should I wear?
Neutral colours, layers.

## 9. How much luggage?
Light, soft bags.

## 10. Is there Wi-Fi?
In many lodges, limited.

## 11. Can I charge my camera?
Yes, in the vehicle and at the lodge.

## 12. What do we eat?
International and local dishes.

## 13. Do we drive all day?
No, usually two drives a day.

## 14. Can children come?
Yes. See [family safari](/blog/family-safari-itinerary/).

## 15. Lodge or tent?
Both are comfortable. See [lodge or tented camp](/blog/lodge-or-tented-camp/).

## 16. How much should I tip?
See [tipping in Tanzania](/blog/tipping-tanzania/).

## 17. Can I pay by card?
Often, but bring cash.

## 18. Do I need binoculars?
Yes!

## 19. What if it rains?
Safaris continue; rain usually passes.

## 20. How do I book?
[Plan your trip with us](/travel-proposal/).
